_comment: Game Text Desk config · source of truth for game-i18n.js · fingerprint store game-i18n-state.json is auto-generated in the same dir · see references/room-game-i18n.md

dictionary._formats: json-per-lang (one JSON per language) / json-single (single file with language sections) / csv (key,zh,en,… Godot-style) · if your engine manages everything (Ren'Py/Unreal), delete this field and just use scan and glossary

scan._notes: dirs = which directories to scan · exts = which extensions · translationMarks = if a line contains these, it counts as already going through a translation function · skip = path prefixes that should not be scanned (logs/debug/dev tools)
